note:
Fizban's Treasury of Dragons (2021).

The effect ids are those of the items imported by DDB Importer; an item from another source keeps the general rules of the
engine, and the parts of a rule that name an id do nothing on it.

records.name: +1 Dragonhide Belt
records.why: Bonus to ki save DCs is limited to ki features; data has only the dawn-recharge ki regain, no effect for the DC bonus.

records.name: +2 Dragonhide Belt
records.why: Bonus to ki save DCs is limited to ki features; data has only the dawn-recharge ki regain, no effect for the DC bonus.

records.name: +3 Dragonhide Belt
records.why: Bonus to ki save DCs is limited to ki features; data has only the dawn-recharge ki regain, no effect for the DC bonus.

records.name: Amethyst Lodestone
records.why: Save advantage and flight exist as effect keys, but the flight charge use and the push on a failed save are not carried; data lacks the push and a flight activity.

records.name: Ascendant Dragon-Touched Focus
records.why: Per-family properties need triggers: d6 bonus on qualifying spell damage, reaction save advantage for others, upcast once per dawn; data has labelled activities but no rules.

records.name: Ascendant Dragon Vessel
records.why: Out-of-combat container that conjures drinks or potions once per dawn; nothing to automate in combat beyond the use itself.

records.name: Ascendant Scaled Ornament
records.why: Aura advantage on charm/fear saves for chosen allies and a reaction to negate breath damage and heal; effects only carry AC, immunity and flight.

records.name: Emerald Pen
records.why: At-will illusory script casting; no combat effect.

records.name: Flail of Tiamat
records.why: Attack with extra elemental damage and a breath save with half on success are carried by the activities; dawn use recharge present. Bonus +3 not visible in structure.

records.name: Gold Canary Figurine of Wondrous Power
records.why: Transforms into a creature with conditions (half HP missing, duration, reverts at 0 HP); data has only a generic utility activity with uses.

records.name: Platinum Scarf
records.why: Choice at use time among heal, shield, hammer; data holds one damage activity only and lacks healing, shield and the extra damage vs chromatic dragons.

records.name: Ruby Weave Gem
records.why: Spellcasting focus with charges to skip costly components and a daily spell pick; no combat effect to automate.

records.name: Sapphire Buckler
records.why: Resistances are carried by the effect, but the reaction thunder damage to an adjacent attacker is a triggered rider; data lacks its damage.

records.name: Slumbering Dragon-Touched Focus
records.why: Initiative advantage is carried by a transferring effect; focus use needs nothing else.

records.name: Slumbering Dragon Vessel
records.why: Out-of-combat container that conjures drinks or potions once per dawn; nothing to automate in combat.

records.name: Slumbering Scaled Ornament
records.why: Advantage on saves against charm and fear conditions only; structure shows no effect or activity, data lacks it.

records.name: Stirring Dragon-Touched Focus
records.why: Per-family properties need triggers: d6 bonus on qualifying spell damage, reaction save advantage for others; data has labelled activities only.

records.name: Stirring Dragon Vessel
records.why: Out-of-combat container that conjures drinks or potions once per dawn; nothing to automate in combat.

records.name: Stirring Scaled Ornament
records.why: Aura advantage on charm/fear saves for chosen creatures nearby; effect carries AC bonus and immunities but not the aura.

records.name: Topaz Annihilator
records.why: Attack activity has no damage and no disintegration on reaching 0 HP; data lacks the necrotic damage and dust rider. Cast activity covers the daily spell.

records.name: Wakened Dragon-Touched Focus
records.why: Per-family properties need triggers (spell damage bonus, reaction save advantage, spell teleport) and once-per-dawn casts per spell; data has only labelled activities.

records.name: Wakened Dragon Vessel
records.why: Out-of-combat container that conjures drinks or potions once per dawn; nothing to automate in combat.

records.name: Wakened Scaled Ornament
records.why: Aura advantage on charm/fear saves for chosen creatures nearby and a reaction negating breath damage with healing; effect only carries AC and immunity.

records.name: Putrid Aura (Acid and Poison Forms Only)
Ashardalon's Stride
records.why: Data has only a plain damage activity; the trail damage on moving near things, once per turn per target, plus no opportunity attacks and speed bonus are missing.

records.name: Draconic Transformation
records.why: Data has the breath save only; bonus-action reuse, blindsight, flying speed and per-turn breath use are not carried by any effect.

records.name: Fizban's Platinum Shield
records.why: Utility activity with no effect: cover, five resistances, evasion on Dex saves and bonus-action moving of the field to another creature are all missing; data lacks them.

records.name: Nathair's Mischief
records.why: Effects exist for conditions only; the per-turn random table roll, cube movement and area-based triggers need a rule.

records.name: Raulothim's Psychic Lance

rule.adds: Incapacitated ends at the start of the caster's next turn.

records.note: Raulothim's Psychic Lance (FTD p.21): the Incapacitated effect ends at the start of the caster's next turn.

records.name: Rime's Binding Ice
records.why: Save and damage are in data; the speed-zero hindrance and its ending by an action to break the ice (by target or adjacent ally) is not expressed.

records.name: Summon Draconic Spirit
records.why: Summon activity covers the creature; the family choice and shared-initiative turn are standard summon handling, little else to add.
